avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces simvastatin levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant

avoid_supplements.name: Red Yeast Rice
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains lovastatin (statin); additive myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue red yeast rice; counsel on statin monotherapy

avoid_supplements.name: Niacin (high-dose >2g/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potentiates myopathy risk and increases statin levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose niacin; monitor CK if low-dose used

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: Statins deplete CoQ10; supplementation may support muscle health
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for myalgia; consider 100-200mg daily if symptoms emerge

caution_supplements.name: Fish Oil (Omega-3)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive lipid-lowering effects; mild bleeding risk at high doses
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor lipid panel and bleeding signs

caution_supplements.name: Garlic
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have minor CYP3A4 induction; additive lipid effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor lipid levels; clinical significance minimal at culinary doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition drastically increases simvastatin levels (up to 16-fold), raising myopathy and rhabdomyolysis risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; counsel on hidden grapefruit in juices and supplements

caution_foods.name: Other Citrus (Pomegranate, Pomegranate Juice)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential weak CYP3A4 inhibition; variable effect
caution_foods.action: Monitor clinical response; adjust if lipid control changes significantly

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Increases GI absorption of simvastatin; may elevate drug levels
caution_foods.action: Take simvastatin consistently with or without food; maintain routine

monitoring_notes: Monitor for myopathy symptoms (muscle pain, weakness, dark urine) especially when initiating therapy or combining with other interacting agents. Check baseline and periodic CK levels, lipid panel, and liver function tests; counsel patients on grapefruit avoidance as primary concern.
